design_bible: light brushed larch plank walls, exposed dark old-wood ceiling beams, wide white-oiled oak floor planks, grey quartzite stone, black steel details, cream wool and cognac leather furniture, black-framed floor-to-ceiling windows, warm indirect lighting, clear winter afternoon light
view: a single snow-covered pyramid-shaped mountain peak with a glacier, above a snowy larch forest

hook_title.fr: Tu paierais combien pour ce chalet ?
hook_title.en: How much would you pay for this chalet?

loop_note: Le pic enneigé du jacuzzi est celui qu'on voyait en arrivant par le chemin.

scenes.visual_prompt: A modern two-level alpine chalet seen from the snowy path leading to its front door: larch plank facade and grey quartzite stone base, black-framed glass, a wide roof overhang covered with snow, the lit oak front door at the end of the path, snowy larch trees on each side
scenes.motion_prompt: smooth steady shot gliding forward along the snowy path toward the lit front door

scenes.visual_prompt: The entrance hall just inside the front door: grey quartzite floor, a long oak bench and black coat hooks on the larch wall, a low ceiling with dark beams
scenes.leads_to: at the far end, a wide opening reveals the bright double-height living room and its huge window onto the mountain peak
scenes.motion_prompt: smooth steady shot gliding forward through the entrance hall toward the wide opening at the far end

scenes.visual_prompt: The double-height living room seen from the entrance: a suspended black steel fireplace in the middle, two cream wool sofas on a grey rug, a huge black-framed glass wall showing the mountain peak
scenes.leads_to: on the right side, a wide opening leads to the kitchen
scenes.motion_prompt: slow steady shot moving forward into the living room, turning slightly to the right toward the kitchen

scenes.visual_prompt: The kitchen next to the living room: a long oak island with a black steel worktop, larch cabinets, a window onto the mountain peak
scenes.leads_to: at the back, an oak staircase climbs to the upper floor
scenes.motion_prompt: slow lateral tracking move along the oak island toward the staircase at the back

scenes.visual_prompt: The library on the upper-floor mezzanine, under the sloping roof beams: floor-to-ceiling oak bookshelves full of books, a cognac leather armchair and a reading lamp, a glass balustrade overlooking the living room below and its big window with the mountain peak
scenes.leads_to: at the end of the mezzanine, an open door leads to the master bedroom
scenes.motion_prompt: slow steady glide along the bookshelves of the mezzanine toward the open door at the end

scenes.visual_prompt: The master bedroom upstairs, under the sloping roof beams: a low oak bed with cream linen facing a black-framed glass wall with the mountain peak
scenes.leads_to: on the left, an open sliding door shows the stone bathroom
scenes.motion_prompt: slow push forward toward the glass wall and the mountain peak

scenes.visual_prompt: The bathroom next to the bedroom: a freestanding grey stone bathtub in front of a large window onto the mountain peak, quartzite walls, larch ceiling
scenes.leads_to: a glass door beside the bathtub opens onto the snowy upstairs terrace
scenes.motion_prompt: slow steady move around the stone bathtub toward the glass door

scenes.visual_prompt: The snow-covered upstairs terrace of the chalet at sunset: a steaming built-in jacuzzi in grey quartzite in the foreground, the larch facade and the big glass wall of the chalet on the left, the mountain peak glowing pink in the last sun
scenes.motion_prompt: the view rises slowly above the steaming jacuzzi revealing the mountain peak at sunset, steam drifting

fr.title: Visite d'un chalet face au pic 🏔️
fr.description: De l'allée enneigée au jacuzzi sur le toit : visite d'un chalet imaginaire en mélèze et quartzite, face à un pic enneigé.

en.title: Inside a chalet facing the peak 🏔️
en.description: From the snowy path to the rooftop hot tub: a tour of an imaginary larch and quartzite chalet facing a snowy peak.
